request.style: English, orchestral, powerful male baritone solo with ethereal choir, grand piano, deep cello, soaring violin, timpani, majestic and triumphant, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I love you Lord my strength
The LORD is my rock and fortress
My deliverer my God my crag
My shield and horn of salvation

[Chorus]
My strength my strength my strength
The LORD is worthy of praise
I call on Him and I am saved
From the grasp of all my enemies

[Verse]
He rescued me from the hand of Saul
From the grip of all who sought my fall
I sing this song on the day of grace
When the LORD delivered me from death

[Chorus]
My strength my strength my strength
The LORD is worthy of praise
I call on Him and I am saved
From the grasp of all my enemies

[Verse]
The cords of death wound round me
The torrents of destruction terrified me
But in His hand I find my rest
My stronghold in the storm of life

[Chorus]
My strength my strength my strength
The LORD is worthy of praise
I call on Him and I am saved
From the grasp of all my enemies

[Outro]
I love you Lord my strength
My rock my fortress my deliverer
